name: net.storelift/storelift
description: App Store & Google Play keyword ranks, rivals, store pages, reviews, charts and AI visibility as an MCP server

environmentVariables.name: STORELIFT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Live Storelift API key from Pro, Studio, Enterprise, or an eligible Free account with purchased API credits or an active Explorer package. Generate at Storelift -> Settings -> API keys. Sandbox keys return sample data only.

environmentVariables.name: STORELIFT_API
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://storelift.net

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <live Storelift API key> from an eligible account. MCP OAuth clients sign in on any plan; tool access depends on plan, scopes and credits.
